$comment: Declarative subagent roster and capability curation. `model` is the canonical provider/model id a Task may be routed to; user-editable model settings remain authoritative for explicit choices. Real costs/context come from models.dev via models-cache.json; price*/context here are offline fallbacks. lane: go-quota = OpenCode Go subscription; sub = user has a subscription (cheap regardless of list price); free = free tier; metered = pay-per-token.

profiles.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash / Vision Exp
profiles.best: Consider only for tasks supported by current exact-model evidence.
profiles.avoid: Do not infer performance from a newer model with a similar name.
profiles.notes: Historical profile; live catalog and benchmark table determine current availability and rank.

profiles.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
profiles.best: Candidate for bounded work when task evidence and current quota support it.
profiles.avoid: Do not infer latency from the Flash name or choose it solely by token price.
profiles.notes: Use the exact effort benchmark and measured whole-task cost.

profiles.name: Hy3
profiles.avoid: everything. Never dispatch hy3, hy4-preview, or hy3-preview.
profiles.notes: Jon: never use Hy3 or Hy4 for anything. Review goes to Sol xhigh or GLM-5.3.

profiles.name: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor (Free)
profiles.best: Free transport candidate when explicitly selected or supported by task evidence.
profiles.avoid: Free access is not evidence of quality, capacity or throughput.
profiles.notes: Keep this before the matching go-quota profile; these are separate transports. No automatic quota fallback over an explicit choice.

profiles.name: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor
profiles.best: Candidate only where exact-model task evidence supports selection.
profiles.avoid: No universal worker default; do not transfer a 1.2 score to 1.3.
profiles.notes: Contributor transport; compare actual task outcomes and permitted quota against other routes.

profiles.name: Kimi K3
profiles.best: Nothing. Jon banned it on 2026-09-17: the cost is high and the work does not justify it. The access policy refuses it.
profiles.avoid: grunt, ops, utility runs, verifications - slow and quota-burning
profiles.notes: $3/$15 per 1M and slow - spend only on design/creative/architecture work.

profiles.name: GPT-6 Astra
profiles.best: Honor explicitly authorized tasks, including the recorded Astra medium keyboard repair. Otherwise select from task evidence.
profiles.avoid: Do not replace an exact choice with another model or infer user charges from list prices.
profiles.notes: Separate subscription transports require exact native pins; no silent provider substitution.

profiles.name: GPT-5.6 Luna Fast
profiles.best: Only an explicitly permitted and supported effort can be considered.
profiles.avoid: Luna medium is prohibited for every role, fallback and resume. An implicit default is insufficient.
profiles.notes: Fast is a service/model label, not proof of reasoning effort or quality. Do not use a lower-effort workaround for the ban.

profiles.name: GPT-5.6 Luna Max
profiles.best: Luna max may be considered when this exact provider route supports it and task evidence justifies it.
profiles.avoid: Never alias an unsupported max setting or fall back to medium or a lower-effort workaround.
profiles.notes: A display name does not establish effective reasoning; validate the selected variant and serialized request. No universal workhorse claim.

profiles.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
profiles.best: when the user names it, or a cheaper model already failed - frontier reasoning, hard design, architecture

profiles.name: Grok 4.6
profiles.best: Consider for tasks justified by current evidence on the configured subscription transport.
profiles.avoid: Do not use xai/* or silently replace an explicitly named route.
profiles.notes: Subscription transport must pass configured access and broker checks. No model-name-based default.

profiles.name: x-preview-f-free
profiles.avoid: production-critical or anything you need to trust
profiles.notes: Zen free preview; no quota cost.
